description: Defines an enum LogLevel representing connection log levels, including SUCCESS and FAILURE, with associated string labels and utility methods for retrieval.

classes.name: LogLevel
classes.description: An enum representing different levels of connection logs, specifically success and failure, with methods to get label and parse from string.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the string label associated with the LogLevel instance.

methods.name: forLevel
methods.description: Static method that returns an Optional containing the LogLevel matching the provided string label, or empty if no match.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString method to return the string label of the LogLevel.
